li.label: Send {A_nameDef} to see to their wounded
li.tip: The colony's doctor goes over to their fire and tends whoever of them is hurt, with the colony's medicine where there is any. They remember it.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} went over to the war party's fire with a bag of bandages and saw to their hurt one by one. {X_nameDef} watched without a word, then gripped {A_nameDef}'s arm hard.
{A_nameDef} spent an hour at the war camp {PLACE}, cleaning and binding what the fight left. "Our own healers are three days behind us," {X_nameDef} said. "This won't be forgotten."

li.label: Pay them for their help ({COUNT} silver)
li.tip: Fighters are paid, where their people come from. Silver for the fight they fought puts the colony in good standing with them, and with their people.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} carried {COUNT} silver over to the war camp. {X_nameDef} counted it, split it among the others, and said their people would hear how the colony dealt with friends.
{X_nameDef} took the silver from {A_nameDef} with a grin. "Now we fought for pay, and we'd have done it for nothing."

texts.li: The fighters of {FACTION} have made camp {PLACE} to rest after the fight.

settled.li: The war party of {FACTION} has its fire going {PLACE}, weapons stacked within reach and the wounded laid out beside it.
The fighters {PLACE} have their camp up: a fire, bedrolls in a ring, and a sentry who never quite sits down.
Smoke rises from the war camp {PLACE}. Someone is singing, badly, and nobody minds.

joinTexts.li: {X_nameDef}, one of the fighters camped {PLACE}, came to the gate with {X_possessive} pack already on. "I've fought for other people long enough. I'd rather fight for mine. Is there a place here?"

{X_nameDef} from the war camp has been eating at the colony's fire more than at {X_possessive} own. Tonight {X_nameDef} asked, plainly, whether the colony could use one more who knows how to hold a line.

farewell.li: The war party of {FACTION} struck their camp {PLACE} at first light and went home, their dead carried between them. {FACTION} will remember who stood with them.
The fighters of {FACTION} are gone from {PLACE}, leaving a ring of trampled grass and a cold fire. {X_nameDef} said, at the gate: "Next time, you come to us."
The war camp {PLACE} is empty. {FACTION}'s people marched off singing the same bad song.

lines.li: Hold still, it's only a scratch.
